records.subject: Welcome aboard, Quartz Group
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Your workspace for Quartz Group is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Quartz Group* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Zara replied warmly but non-committally ("planning to dig in properly soon") [email:a6164c23], no-showed kickoff [calendar:55d6fb81], and ignored two earlier emails [email:26450310, email:ac50453e]. No project, no invite at day 6 with 8 days left; intent exists but momentum is weak.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Thanks for getting back to me -- totally understand it's been a busy week, and no pressure at all.

When you do dig in, the one thing worth starting with is a real project: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, so it's a quick start.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and help you set up that first project together -- just tell me a time that suits you.

Best,
Chidi
